items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Heads to locker room Sunday
items.description:
Stevenson headed to the locker room during Sunday's game against the Packers to be evaluated for an unspecified issue, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bryce Young: Three TDs not enough Sunday
items.description:
Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos. He added 13 yards on his only carry and lost a fumble.

items.title: Pat Bryant: Makes impact in return to action
items.description:
Bryant caught four of five targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over Carolina.
